title: Most Hessdalen residents report experiences

tellings.quote:
it was very easy to tell that an
[snorts] extremely high percentage of
people that lived there had experienced
things like
>> upwards of 80 85 90% of people

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says he visited Hessdalen, a valley in Norway known for strange lights, and talked with the people who live there. He says it was easy to see that a very high share of residents, upwards of 80 to 90 percent by his estimate, had experienced something odd themselves. If true, it would make Hessdalen a place where these experiences are ordinary local life, not rare events.
